source_note: Structured reference for control effects and other combat mechanics. Control effect rules are based on the user-supplied Control Effects article.

control_effects.description: Some heroes apply control effects that prevent affected heroes from performing certain actions and can significantly affect the course of battle.

stun.effect: A stunned hero cannot move or attack.

application_methods.condition: Damage dealt by one attack is greater than 20% of the opponent's maximum Health.

blind.effect: A blinded hero misses physical damage from both attacks and abilities.

silence.effect: A silenced hero can only deal physical damage and use skills that scale with Physical Attack.
blocked_skill_categories: Skills that do not deal damage.
Skills that scale with Magic Attack.

examples.reason: The skill does not deal damage.
The skill deals physical damage but scales with Magic Attack, so Silence prevents its use.

slow.effect: Reduces basic attack speed and increases ability cooldowns.

charm.effect: A charmed hero cannot attack or cast abilities.
charm.removal_condition: Damage from any character other than the character who applied Charm can remove the effect.

throwing_in_the_air.visual_indicator_note: No special status sign marks this effect.
throwing_in_the_air.effect: Affected heroes cannot attack or use skills.

displacement.visual_indicator_note: No special status sign marks this effect.
displacement.effect: Affected heroes cannot attack or use skills.

cleanse_and_block_example.effect: Clears and blocks negative effects, including Displacement and Throwing in the Air.

observacao: DoT não é uma estatistica, mas sim um efeito de dano que ocorre ao longo do tempo. e nao deve ser considerado como stats.
damage_over_time.purpose: Removes battle delays caused by heroes generating many repeated damage effects.

affected_sources.effect: Pure damage from the third skill.
Damage from the second, third, and fourth skills.
Burn damage from the first skill.
Burn damage from the fourth skill.
Damage from the third skill enhanced by a Relic.
Pure damage equal to a percentage of heroes' maximum Health.

changes: Effects from Tempus's clock that increase maximum Health and apply slow or speed-up do not affect heroes while they are unavailable.
Those effects apply once unavailable heroes become available again, as long as they are within the clock's area.
Effects from Tempus's clock can be applied again if removed, as long as the hero remains inside the clock.
tempus_fourth_skill.previous_behavior: Effects from Tempus's clock could be removed permanently.

rules.description: A hero gains 100 energy for each basic attack or skill they use.

rules.energy_gained: 1% energy for every 1% of total health lost as damage
rules.description: Heroes gain energy based on the percentage of their total health lost. Lower-health heroes can sometimes reach their ultimate faster.
The hero who delivers the final blow gains 300 extra energy.
If the final blow also counts as an attack or skill use, the hero gains 100 energy from the action plus 300 from the kill.
Some Mages can gain additional energy at the start of battle based on their Class Rune level.

ultimate_energy.summary: A hero must reach 1,000 energy to use the ultimate skill. Energy is gained by using abilities, taking damage, defeating enemies, and in some cases through Class Rune bonuses.
